ChatCompletionMessage(content='Here’s the full list of functions that are currently available for use:

### File‑system tools (Gorilla)

| Function | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| **`cat`** | Display the contents of a file (no path, only file name). |
| **`cp`** | Copy a file or directory to another location (no paths, only names). |
| **`diff`** | Compare two files line‑by‑line. |
| **`du`** | Estimate disk usage of a directory (human‑readable option). |
| **`echo`** | Write content to a file or display it. |
| **`find`** | Recursively search for files/directories by name (or list all). |
| **`grep`** | Search for a pattern inside a file. |
| **`ls`** | List contents of the current directory (optionally show hidden). |
| **`mkdir`** | Create a new directory. |
| **`mv`** | Move or rename a file/directory. |
| **`pwd`** | Return the current working directory. |
| **`rm`** | Remove a file. |
| **`rmdir`** | Remove an empty directory. |
| **`sort`** | Sort the lines of a file. |
| **`tail`** | Show the last N lines of a file. |
| **`touch`** | Create an empty file. |
| **`wc`** | Count lines, words, or characters in a file. |
| **`cd`** | Change the current working directory (one level at a time). |

### Math tools (Math API)

| Function | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| **`absolute_value`** | Compute the absolute value of a number. |
| **`add`** | Add two numbers. |
| **`divide`** | Divide one number by another. |
| **`imperial_si_conversion`** | Convert between imperial and SI units. |
| **`logarithm`** | Compute a logarithm with adjustable precision. |
| **`max_value`** | Find the maximum in a list of numbers. |
